_comment: THE ONE PLACE the plugin's identity lives. Everything that carries it — .claude-plugin/plugin.json, .codex-plugin/plugin.json and the 92 permission rules in skills/soc-investigate/settings.snippet.json — is GENERATED from this file by gen_identity.py; CI fails if they drift. To re-brand or re-key the plugin (e.g. a vendor catalog shipping it under its own name), change `name`/`displayName`/`description` here and run `python3 plugin/gen_identity.py`. `name` is load-bearing: it is the Claude Code plugin key and the skill/MCP namespace prefix (`<name>:<skill>`, `mcp__plugin_<name>_<server>__<tool>`) that the permission gate matches on.
name: socxen
shortDescription: Triage Exabeam New-Scale alerts and cases end to end — evidence, verdict, and a guarded write path.
description: socxen — agentic SOC analyst skill suite. Investigates and triages Exabeam New-Scale alerts and cases through the Exabeam MCP: evidence gathering, entity pivots, threat/false-positive verdict, and action — with containment recommended for human approval and dismiss/close gated by the host agent's tool-approval rules.
